newsitem.title: UK: UK will not advance telecom price cap end-minister.
newsitem.headline: UK will not advance telecom price cap end-minister.

text.p: The government does not intend to lift the price-capping system on residential telecoms services before 2001 despite the rapid advance of effective competition, technology minister Ian Taylor said on Wednesday.
"I have no doubt that 2001 will be the key date," Taylor told parliament's Trade and Industry Committee.
Committee members had suggested to Taylor that, because of technological advances, the government should look again at its planned date with a view to bringing it forward.
But Taylor told them: "Everyone has made their investment decisions against a particular background, and I don't want to disturb that." -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
